messages.label: scam
messages.text: hey dad its Jess, using my mates phone cos mine went for a swim at Bondi lol. Can u do me a quick favour? rent is due today and my bank app has locked me out, can u PayID $1,200 to my housemate and I'll sort u out next week. dont call this one its hers
messages.note: Unknown number posing as daughter, new phone excuse, urgent payment to a third party's account

messages.label: scam
messages.text: ATO: We were unable to process your 2025-26 lodgement as your myGov details do not match our records. Avoid a late lodgement penalty, re-confirm your identity today: [link]
messages.note: ATO never sends links asking you to sign in; threat of penalty plus link

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Australia Post: we tried to deliver your item today but the street number was missing. A $2.95 re-delivery charge applies, please book a new slot here [link] or it will be sent back to the sender.
messages.note: Fake AusPost text with link and small fee; AusPost never asks for payment by text

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: Good afternoon, it's Daniel from Westpac's security operations. I can see two login attempts from a device in Perth this morning. Just to be safe, I'm going to open a protected holding account under your name and walk you through moving your savings across while we lock down the old one. Have you got your banking app open?
messages.note: Fake bank fraud team asking you to transfer funds to a 'protected' account

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hello! Your profile was recommended to us by a recruitment agency. We are looking for part-time online staff to help merchants boost app rankings, simple tasks on your phone, daily pay of $250-$600 directly to your account. Are you over 22 and have an hour a day free? 😊
messages.note: Unsolicited recruiter, vague phone tasks with high daily pay, typical task-job opener

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: Hi there, I'm a technician with the NBN network team. Your modem has been sending out error signals and someone overseas is using your IP address. Could you go to your computer now and type in a website I'll give you, so I can connect and run a security scan for you?
messages.note: Cold call from 'NBN technician' trying to get remote control of the computer

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Morning beautiful, I hope you slept well. I told my daughter about you last night and she said I've been smiling more lately. Work in Dubai is crazy so I can't do video yet, the site rules are strict, but I promise when this contract ends I'll be on the first plane to Brisbane. Have you thought more about the platform I mentioned? I'd love to help you start slowly.
messages.note: HARD: affectionate stranger avoiding video, hinting at an investment platform; no link or direct ask

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Your McAfee Total Protection subscription has been renewed automatically. Amount charged: $649.99 AUD. Invoice no. [number]. If you wish to cancel and receive a full refund, please contact our billing desk on [number] within 24 hours.
messages.note: Fake renewal invoice pushing you to call a number for a 'refund'

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hi mate, I'll take the bike for the full $450. I've sent the money by PayID but it says your account needs to be upgraded to a business account to receive it. Check your email, you just need to follow their link and they'll release it. My boy is so excited!
messages.note: Fake buyer with PayID 'upgrade' story to steal the seller's money or banking login

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Got your $380, thanks heaps! Just one thing, Ticketmaster flagged the transfer as resale so they want a $95 verification charge before the seats land in your account. Can you send that through quick? Otherwise they'll void both tickets tonight 😩
messages.note: Ticket seller asking for an extra 'verification' fee after payment

messages.label: scam
messages.text: DoorDash: Hi, we saw your last order was charged twice. So we can credit $43.20 back to your card, please reply with the verification number you're about to receive.
messages.note: HARD: polite, no link; asks for the one-time code to take over the account

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: Is that Margaret? It's Ruth from your bank's card services. Your debit card details have been copied at a petrol station, so we're cancelling it for you. I'll just need you to pop it in an envelope with a note of your PIN so we can match it up, and our driver will pick it up from the letterbox this arvo. New one's in the post.
messages.note: HARD: calm caller asking for PIN and card left in the letterbox for collection

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Your NAB verification code is [number]. NAB will never call you to ask for this code. Don't share it with anyone.
messages.note: Genuine one-time code that warns not to share it; nothing requested

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Australia Post: Your parcel from Kmart is with a driver and will be delivered today. Track it in the AusPost app with tracking no. [number].
messages.note: Real delivery notice, no payment or personal details requested

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hi Mum, the mechanic rang, the Corolla needs new brakes before rego and it's $640. Any chance you could lend me half till payday on the 28th? Same as last time with the fridge, I'll pay you back. Love you, see you Sunday for Nan's birthday
messages.note: Child from usual number with personal context and repayment history; normal family request

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Reminder from the ATO: if you're lodging your own tax return, it's due by 31 October. To lodge or check your details, sign in to ATO online services through myGov yourself or use the ATO app. We will never send you a link to log in.
messages.note: Tax reminder that tells you to log in yourself, no link

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Mate did you see this? Linkt are putting tolls up again on the M7 next year, absolute rort [link]. Might have to start taking the back way to work haha
messages.note: Friend sharing a news article link, no request

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hi all, urgent: the Year 9 excursion forms for Thursday must be returned by 3pm tomorrow or students can't attend. Hard copies went home on Monday; drop them at the front office. Thanks, Year 9 Coordinator
messages.note: School message with deadline but no link, payment or personal data request

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Thanks for shopping with JB Hi-Fi! Order [number] is confirmed: 1 x Sony WH-1000XM5 headphones, $449.00 paid by Visa ending [number]. We'll email you when it's ready for click & collect at your selected store.
messages.note: Order confirmation for a real purchase, no action needed

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Reminder: you have an appointment with Dr Sarah at the clinic on Tue 18 Nov at 10:15am. Please bring your Medicare card. Reply C to confirm or call the clinic to reschedule.
messages.note: Normal GP appointment reminder

messages.label: safe
messages.text: G'day it's Tom from footy, finally switched to Telstra so this is my new number. Save it over the old one. See you at training Wednesday
messages.note: Friend announcing a new number and asking for nothing

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hi, is the dining table still available? Does it come apart for transport or will I need a ute? I'm in Parramatta and could pick up Saturday morning, happy to pay cash on collection.
messages.note: Ordinary marketplace buyer question, pays cash in person

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Virgin Australia: Due to an operational change, your flight VA[number] to Cairns on Friday has been rescheduled to 6:05am. If the new time doesn't suit, choose a free alternative or a refund within 12 hours: [link]
messages.note: Fake schedule change pushing you to a look-alike rebooking page

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hi Paul, great to hear from you about the 2020 Mazda CX-5. It's still on the lot and we can hold it at the online price of $21,500 until Thursday close of business. Once the deposit clears we arrange door-to-door transport anywhere in Australia, normally 5-7 days. I've attached the tax invoice with our ABN and bank details. Cheers, Michael, Sales Manager
messages.note: HARD: polished dealer reply with invoice and bank transfer for a car you can't inspect

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: Good morning, Senior Constable Ben Walsh, AFP cybercrime. You should have just received an email from us with a ReportCyber reference. Your name came up in a breach of a crypto exchange and someone tried to log in from overseas. I'll stay on the line with you, can you read me the PIN in that email so I can confirm it's you? Then a security officer from your exchange will call to protect your coins.
messages.note: Fake AFP caller with a fake ReportCyber report wanting the PIN and a hand-off

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Thanks for joining the Sunday Fishing Mates chat 🎣 A few of us also follow Professor Grant's market notes, he's helped me pay off the boat this year. He's doing a free beginners session tonight at 8 if you want to sit in, no pressure mate.
messages.note: HARD: friendly hobby group steering newcomers to a 'professor' trading guru

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Optus: Your SIM swap request has been received and your new eSIM will be active within 1 hour. If you did not request this, reply STOP immediately.
messages.note: HARD: Unexpected SIM/eSIM swap notice; reply-to-stop lures victim while the number is taken

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Dear Ashley, good news, your application for a $12,000 personal loan has been conditionally approved. Before settlement we require a once-off loan protection premium of $640, refundable after your sixth repayment. Please pay to the trust account in the attached letter and send the receipt along with a photo of your licence.
messages.note: Fake lender asking for an upfront 'protection' fee before releasing funds

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hello Chris. I know you live in Geelong and your mobile ends in [number]. I've had access to your laptop camera for months and I have recordings you would not want your workmates to see. You have 48 hours to send $2,000 AUD in Bitcoin to the wallet below. After that, everyone in your contacts gets the file.
messages.note: Sextortion email with partial personal details from a breach, crypto demand

messages.label: scam
messages.text: TikTok Safety Team: Under the new Australian minimum age rules your account has been flagged as possibly under 16. To keep your videos and followers, complete age verification by uploading your driver licence or passport within 24 hours: [link]
messages.note: Fake platform age-check asking for ID documents through a link

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hi Mum it's me, this is my new number, old phone's busted. Are you around? Got a bit of a situation, I'll explain when you reply x
messages.note: HARD: first message of a 'Hi Mum' con, no ask yet, just a new number

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Recorded voice: This is an urgent message from the Australian Taxation Office. A legal case has been lodged against your tax file number for unpaid tax. To avoid arrest, press 1 now to speak to an ATO officer.
messages.note: Robocall impersonating the ATO with arrest threat

messages.label: scam
messages.text: StarTrack: your parcel is being held at the depot. Customs duty of $3.40 is outstanding before it can be released. Pay here: [link]
messages.note: Courier text with a small 'customs' fee link

messages.label: scam
messages.text: CommBank: A new device was added to your NetBank at 11:42pm. If this wasn't you, call our fraud team on [number] straight away so we can secure your funds.
messages.note: Text pushing you to call a fake fraud line, which leads to a safe-account transfer

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hi Olivia, great job today! You completed 38 of 40 product ratings. To unlock the final 2 combined orders and withdraw your $1,120 commission, your work account needs a top-up of $480 in USDT. This is refunded with your earnings.
messages.note: Task job asking the worker to 'top up' to release commission

messages.label: scam
messages.text: I hate even asking this, you know how much I care about you. My site payroll in Abu Dhabi is stuck because of an audit and the landlord is threatening to throw me out. If you could cover $2,300 until Friday, I'll send it back plus enough for your flight over. I'd never ask if I had anyone else.
messages.note: HARD: Online partner who has never met you now asking for money

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Gumtree Payments: Your item 'Weber Q BBQ' has been paid for by the buyer ($320.00). To release the funds to your account, please confirm your card details on the secure seller page: [link]
messages.note: Fake marketplace payout email asking for card details

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: Hello, this is Steven from Telstra's technical team. We've noticed your home internet is about to be disconnected because your router has been compromised. I just need you to download a small app called AnyDesk so I can check it for you, it only takes five minutes.
messages.note: Cold call claiming to be telco support asking to install remote access

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Westpac: We've blocked a card transaction of $389.00 at an online store that looked unusual. If this wasn't you, please call us on the number on the back of your card. We'll never ask for your PIN or passwords.
messages.note: Genuine fraud alert pointing to the number on the card, no link

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Australia Post: We couldn't deliver your parcel today as no one was home. It's now at your local Post Office and can be collected from tomorrow with photo ID. Tracking no. [number].
messages.note: Real missed-delivery notice, no payment or link

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hey Dad, footy rego for the season is $180, it closes Friday. Coach said we can pay at the club rooms Thursday night if that's easier. Can you come to training and sort it? Love Sam
messages.note: Child from usual number, legit payment in person at the club

messages.label: safe
messages.text: 🎉 GIVEAWAY 🎉 To celebrate 5 years, we're giving away a $100 voucher! To enter: follow us, like this post and tag a mate. Winner drawn Friday and announced here, we'll never ask for payment or card details. Good luck! - The Corner Bakery Newtown
messages.note: Real shop giveaway on its own page, nothing to pay or provide

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hi team, the Woolworths audit has been brought forward to tomorrow at 7am, so I need all stock counts entered in the system before you finish your shift today. Apologies for the rush. Thanks, Karen (Store Manager)
messages.note: Urgent work email from manager, internal system only

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Your myGov code is [number]. Don't share this code with anyone. We'll never ask for it.
messages.note: Real 2FA code with do-not-share warning

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hi Ryan, just confirming as discussed at the inspection, rent from 1 December will be $620 per week, paid as usual into the same account set up with the agency. No other changes to your lease. Regards, Linda, Property Manager
messages.note: Landlord's agent confirming an agreed rent with no new account details

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hey it's Emma! Dropped my phone in the pool so got a new one and a new number. Old one's dead. All good, don't need anything, just save this one. See you at Kate's birthday
messages.note: Friend with a new phone, asks for nothing

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hi, is the couch still available? Any stains or pet hair? I'm in Penrith and can pick it up Sunday with my brother's trailer. Cash ok?
messages.note: Normal marketplace buyer questions with cash pickup

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Reminder from Services Australia: your Centrelink reporting is due in 2 days. To report, sign in to your myGov account yourself or use the Express Plus Centrelink app. We'll never send you a link to sign in.
messages.note: Government reminder telling you to sign in yourself

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hi it's the office at Riverside Primary. Due to the storm warning, school will close at 1pm today. Please arrange to collect your child from 1pm or they'll be supervised in the hall until 3pm.
messages.note: Urgent school notice with no link or request

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Qantas: Your flight QF[number] to Melbourne on 20 Nov is now departing at 4:10pm due to aircraft scheduling. No action is needed. View your booking in the Qantas app.
messages.note: Real flight time change, no link or payment, use the app yourself
